explication: Fold Craft Launcher is an Android Minecraft: Java Edition launcher. The principal workflow is: a player selects a profile/version, the launcher resolves game content and account state, starts the Java game through the Android runtime/rendering backend, and provides touch/controller input during play. Separate branches cover downloads and resource management, authentication, themes, plugins, custom controls, and Terracotta multiplayer. The tree and README establish these capabilities; only sampled source supports detailed service relationships, so several unsampled UI-to-domain links are intentionally omitted.
